candidates.title: Taken underground by elevator at NSWC Crane

link.reason: Randy Anderson's own account of being taken down by elevator into an underground part of NSWC Crane is the event the existing story describes.
link.difference: Told firsthand, with a 2014 date and the detail of moving to another building before taking the elevator down.

candidates.quote: it almost looked like a mirage type of effect and in that above that display screen were these hieroglyphic symbols that I started to see appear

link.reason: The gauntlet object with moving symbols is one object inside the Crane visit. The visit story only quotes it in passing, so it is a narrower, distinct story.

candidates.title: Green orb over the Nevada test range during training
candidates.quote: during that time a green orb type object had flown over and my buddy had seen it

link.reason: A buddy's sighting of a green orb over the Nevada range during training is a different event from the triangle and S4 stories.

candidates.title: Black triangle hovering at Area 51
candidates.quote: he told me off air that he's seen a black triangle hovering around at the notorious flight testing facility that he believed was employing exotic electrogravitic propulsion

link.reason: Jesse Michels relays Randy Anderson's sighting of triangles at Area 51, which is the same story already held.
link.difference: Describes a single black triangle hovering rather than triangles taking off, and adds Anderson's belief that it used electrogravitic propulsion.

candidates.title: Livelsberger email: New Jersey drones are Chinese gravitic drones
candidates.quote: Matthew had emailed him saying that the New Jersey drones that the entire country has been confused about for the last two months are actually state-of-the-art gravitic propulsion drones from China

link.reason: Both describe the Cybertruck bomber Livelsberger's email to Shoemate, as told on Shawn Ryan's show, claiming the drones were Chinese gravitic craft.
link.difference: Names Livelsberger and the New Jersey drones of the past two months, and credits the FBI; the story places the drones on the Eastern Seaboard.

candidates.title: Livelsberger email gives Area 51 coordinates for gravitic propulsion center
candidates.quote: this very weird email sent by Matthew displays the coordinates of America gravitic propulsions Operation Center the coordinates are at Area 51

link.reason: This telling is about the email's claim of Area 51 coordinates for a US gravitic propulsion operations center. That is a separate claim from the Chinese-drone story, and no story holds it.

candidates.title: Nuclear test sites with Marines dug in nearby

link.reason: Marines dug in close to nuclear detonations at the Nevada Test Site is not in any story. The Bissell story about Area 51's location is a different piece of place-lore.

candidates.title: UFOs at nuclear sites and blast plumes (Hastings)
candidates.quote: they consistently report seeing UFOs showing up not only in and around uh nuclear assets but actually in and around the plume of nuclear blasts and Atmospheric tests

link.reason: Both tell of Robert Hastings' book UFOs and Nukes and its witnesses reporting UFOs around US nuclear assets.
link.difference: Adds that UFOs were seen in the plumes of nuclear blasts and atmospheric tests.
